No never-named, vague, or re-chunk-stranded referent anywhere in the body. Harm absent.

Header 'Every task maps onto the same six phases' (line 3) is confirmed by the chunk's own line 5 ('Every piece of agentic work maps onto the same cycle...') and the six-bullet enumeration (lines 9-14) that immediately follows — a literally true summary of everything else on the slide. Per sub-item, over body lines 1-17 plus the figure's label text (`node scripts/expand-md.js curriculum/lectures/the-whole-map.md`, all `<text>` content): (a) 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction — none. (b) Anaphora/epistrophe triples — none; the figure's short verb chains ('act · read the result · correct', 'run · let it fail · shape the verifier · re-run', 'read · judge · gate what ships · by hand for now') are mechanism lists of 3-4 items, not repeated sentence-opener/closer triples. rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is a lecture, so `##` headings must be claims, not imperative/label. 'Every task maps onto the same six phases' (line 3) is a declarative claim the chunk then substantiates (six defined phases, a places-not-pipeline closer) — satisfies the claim requirement cleanly. The file's only other former heading, 'You are here' (an orientation-header NOT-violation example the rule text names verbatim), was cut from the body 2026-08-29 and is no longer present to score.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Checked every bullet on the one remaining slide (lines 9-14) plus the trailing closer sentence (line 16) against the three classes. (a) Doctrine restatement: none of the six phase bullets re-announces a split/lens/law already stated earlier in this file — each is a first-time naming of a distinct phase with its own content. (b) Self-referential design commentary: no bullet talks about the training's own pedagogy or design choices (the M1/'you are here' material that most risked this class was cut from the body entirely 2026-08-29). (c) Aphorism kicker: line 16, 'The phases are places, not a pipeline. A real task sits in several at once.' is the closest candidate for a closing koan — it stays inside because it adds a genuinely new architectural claim (phases overlap rather than run in sequence) rather than restating the header ('...maps onto the same six phases') or any stated point line; it is load-bearing for the map's own non-linear framing, not decorative. No bullet fails all three tests.
